subject: Re: Zenlytics POC - success criteria, timeline and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@zenlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Zenlytics POC - success criteria & next steps (recap)

Hi Laura — great to meet today, thanks for your time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned going into the POC: 

1) Goals / success criteria (what Zenlytics wants to validate):
- Ingest and index 6 months of support tickets and product docs into embeddings + search UI; precision@5 > 80% on our internal query set.
- Latency: typical query latency < 250ms 95th percentile for your weekly batch size (~40 qps burst).
- Cost: estimate < $0.02/query at target load using Redwood Dedicated with our batching settings.

2) Scope / deliverables:
- Redwood will provide a sandbox deployment + UI, embedding pipeline, sample evaluation harness, and run weekly syncs for two weeks of active testing.
- Zenlytics will provide a 50k-row sample of anonymized tickets + access to a small set of representative queries and expected answers.

3) Timeline (proposed):
- Thu 2/26: data handoff (sample)
- Mon 3/1: sandbox deployed, baseline index complete
- Week of 3/1: initial evals and tuning
- Wed 3/10: POC wrap / review + decision meeting

4) Owners: Redwood (Marissa / Vivek) for deployment and tuning; Zenlytics (Laura / Ben) for data & acceptance tests; Monica (CS) will own onboarding tasks and runbook.

Action items:
- Laura/Ben: confirm data handoff on 2/26 and share sample schema / S3 link.
- Marissa: send success criteria workbook and data instructions (attached).

Attaching the success criteria workbook and a short data handoff checklist. If anything above looks off, tell me and I’ll update. Otherwise I’ll schedule a 30-minute sync for 3/1 to review the sandbox baseline.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

--
Attachment: zenlytics_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
Attachment: sample_data_instructions.txt (text, 1KB)

From: Laura Chen <laura@zenlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Torres <ben.torres@zenlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Zenlytics POC - success criteria & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is perfect and aligned with what we discussed. Quick notes / clarifications: 

- We can deliver the 50k anonymized tickets by 2/26. We will provide S3 access to a single bucket. I attached the schema file in my original email (resending if needed).
- Precision@5 target: 80% is our stretch target; minimum viable is 70% — happy if we call out both.
- For latency: 250ms 95p is ideal, but we understand test conditions may vary.

Questions:
1) Can you confirm what data format you prefer for the tickets (CSV vs JSONL)?
2) Do you need any API keys or IP allowlist entries from our side for the sandbox?

We’re available for the 3/1 sync; Ben will own the data handoff.

Best,
Laura
Laura Chen | Head of Product, Zenlytics
laura@zenlytics.com | +1 650-555-0199

--
Attachment: zenlytics_ticket_schema_v1.json (text, 3KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@zenlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Torres <ben.torres@zenlytics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Zenlytics POC - success criteria & next steps

Laura — thanks, perfect. Quick answers: 
- Format: JSONL is preferred (one event per line), but CSV is fine if you have export constraints. Sample instructions are attached.
- Access: We’ll need an S3 read-only role and an IP allowlist entry for the sandbox control plane (I listed the IP ranges in the instructions). No API keys required from your infra side.

I’ve scheduled the 3/1 10:00 AM PT sync — invite sent. Vivek and Monica will join to own deployment and onboarding. 

Marissa

On a related note, Vivek — could you confirm roughly how long baseline indexing and initial evals will take once we get the sample (50k docs)? Planning for 1 business day to index + a day for initial tuning?

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Zenlytics POC - success criteria & next steps

On Thu, Feb 26, 2026 at 10:01 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> On a related note, Vivek — could you confirm roughly how long baseline indexing and initial evals will take once we get the sample (50k docs)? Planning for 1 business day to index + a day for initial tuning?

Marissa / team — yes, that timeline is realistic. Plan: 
- Day 0 (depending on when we get the S3 link): spin up sandbox, confirm access.
- Day 1: run ETL -> embeddings -> index (estimate 4-6 hours for 50k docs on the sandbox profile).
- Day 2: run initial eval harness, tune encoder settings and similarity thresholds, and produce baseline metrics.

I’ll prepare a short checklist for the team with the sample format expectations and the minimal sample queries we need. Also will ask for a snippet of the real query set (10–20 queries) from Laura to seed the eval.

— Vivek
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Zenlytics POC - success criteria & next steps (sandbox deployed)

Thanks Ben — I can confirm we have access and the files look good. Vivek completed the baseline index this morning and ran initial evals. Early notes:
- Baseline precision@5 (un-tuned): 68%
- Median query latency: 160ms (sandbox profile)
- Missing: a few long-form ticket fields require cleaning to avoid noisy embeddings — Vivek will send a short cleaning rule set.

Next steps for this week (owner in parentheses):
- Vivek: share cleaning rules + run tuned index by Wed 3/3.
- Monica: schedule a short training session on the sandbox UI for Zenlytics product team (Thu 3/4, 11 AM PT).
- Laura/Ben: provide a 10–20 query gold set for acceptance tests by Wed 3/3.

I’ll follow up mid-week with a quick status nudge. If anything blocks you, highlight here.

Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Marissa
